_about: Character panels for the battle map. Mirror of thal-party-sheets.md: update whenever the sheets change. Per character: resources (counters), slots, use (things you can do; kind = action | bonus | reaction | free | rest; spells carry lvl, 0 = cantrip; `needs` names a resource), passive (always on), spellbook (known but not prepared), equipped, inventory. `shared` is the Party pack (its own panel). Per-fight counts go on the token as `res`, e.g. {"1st": "4/6", "Action Surge": "0/1"}.
